text:
Sen. Kim Ward highlights record state grant awards and promotes hiking resources
T. O. Webb
Sen. Kim Ward, Pennsylvania Senate Majority Leader, has recently highlighted changes to the state budget and outdoor recreation in a series of posts on her official X account.
On August 31, 2026, Ward announced an increase in the maximum Pennsylvania State Grant award for higher education. She wrote, "Under the new state budget we recently passed, the maximum PA State Grant award has increased to the highest amount in program history, helping students across the commonwealth and their families pay for higher education. The maximum award is $6,000 for 2026-27." The grant program provides financial assistance to eligible Pennsylvania residents pursuing postsecondary education.
The following day, September 1, 2026, Ward shared a brief post containing only a link: "https://t.co/DEWTxSdf2o" No additional context was provided in this message.
Later on September 1, Ward posted about outdoor activities in Pennsylvania. She stated, "Hiking is the most popular outdoor activity in PA. If you’re a novice, you can learn about what to wear and carry, trail etiquette, what to do if lost – as well as find the nearest trail – here: https://t.co/5p63wrX4Ss https://t.co/w5tw16TOLz".
Sen. Kim Ward serves as Senate Majority Leader in Pennsylvania and frequently uses her social media platforms to communicate legislative updates and community resources.
